title: Brand assets
description: Official wordmarks, responsive favicons, and transparent figurines ready to place.
markdown:
--- title: Brand assets description: Official wordmarks, responsive favicons, and transparent figurines ready to place. sidebar: icon: image order: 3 --- Identity files live under `/brand/shaughv/`. Link them. Do not redraw the mark or recrop a figurine unless you are producing a new named asset. ## Wordmark The static fallback when the animated mark is not loaded. ![Official SHAUGHV wordmark](/blume-assets/content/docs/images/wordmark.svg) SHAUGHV-Official.svg ```html ``` On dark surfaces, invert the SVG with CSS rather than shipping a second file: ```css .wordmark-on-olive { filter: brightness(0) invert(1); } ``` ## Favicons The pair follows the visitor's color scheme: dark mark on light browser chrome, light mark on dark chrome.
![Dark SHAUGHV favicon](/blume-assets/content/docs/images/favicon-dark.svg) Dark favicon Light scheme
![Light SHAUGHV favicon](/blume-assets/content/docs/images/favicon-light.svg) Light favicon Dark scheme
```html ``` Alternate marks also exist: - `SHAUGHV-Favicon-Dark-Alt.svg` - `SHAUGHV-Favicon-Light-Alt.svg` ## Figurines Transparent WebP files sit on cream, color, or photography without a baked-in background. Transparent set under /brand/shaughv/figurines/transparent/. ![Figurine of Shaughv pointing at his vintage Mac.](/blume-assets/content/docs/images/figurine-look-at-this.webp) figurine-look-at-this.webp ![SHAUGHV figurine header pose.](/blume-assets/content/docs/images/figurine-header.webp) figurine-header.webp ![SHAUGHV figurine with mail.](/blume-assets/content/docs/images/figurine-mail.webp) figurine-mail.webp ```html ``` Non-transparent counterparts live one directory up, for cases that already provide a solid stage. - brand/shaughv/ - logos/SHAUGHV-Official.svg - favicons/ - SHAUGHV-Favicon-Dark.svg - SHAUGHV-Favicon-Light.svg - SHAUGHV-Favicon-Dark-Alt.svg - SHAUGHV-Favicon-Light-Alt.svg - figurines/ - figurine-header.webp - figurine-look-at-this.webp - transparent/ - figurine-header.webp - figurine-look-at-this.webp
